{{Quote|How's our latest poster boy for the horrors of war doing?|Jos Vondar, asking Zan Yant about N'do Maetrecis's status|<ref name="MedStar I" />}}
'''N'do Maetrecis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], after being injured in a [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar]], he underwent a [[Heart/Legends|heart]] transplant due to a shrapnel injury. Afterward, Maetrecis then contracted a [[Disease/Legends|disease]] from Drongar's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]], though [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zan Yant]] managed to successfully treat the persistent ailment using an illegal healing substance&mdash;the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Bota/Legends|bota]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All right. What's going on here?''"<br />"''Going on? What are you talking about?''"<br />"''I'm talking about a patient who comes out of a life-threatening secondary infection so fast he leaves ion burns on his chart. I’m also talking about treatment with unmarked skinpoppers.''"<br />"''You didn't.''"<br />"''I did.|Jos Vondar and Zan Yant, as the former confronted the latter about his treatment of N'do Maetrecis|<ref name="MedStar I" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] N'do Maetrecis was active during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Great Peace of the Republic|reign]]. He served as a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="MedStar I" />

[[File:Zan_Yant.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Zan Yant (pictured) saved N'do Maetrecis's life by treating him with bota, despite the plant being illegal to administer.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Maetrecis was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|274|Maetrecis, N'do}}</ref> fighting in a [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] where he was wounded by shrapnel. [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] [[Doctor/Legends|surgeons]] succeeded in conducting a [[Heart/Legends|heart]] transplant on him, though the procedure took several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="MedStar I" /> Shortly afterward, Maetrecis then contracted one of many unknown [[Disease/Legends|diseases]] found in Drongar's [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> As his skin turned pale and anhidrotic,<ref name="MedStar I" /> doctors struggled to discover the root cause of his ailment and fretted as [[Antibiotic/Legends|antibiotic]] medicine failed to combat his infection.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Medical personnel attempted several techniques&mdash;such as [[macromolecular regeneration]], [[nanocell implant]]s, and [[maser cauterization]]&mdash;to no success. As Maetrecis lay ill, a member of [[The Silent]] kept a vigil from outside the major's sterile isolation chamber&mdash;holding a vow of silence&mdash;which was believed by some individuals to passively assist healing.<ref name="MedStar I" />

In response, Doctor [[Zan Yant]] used<ref name="MedStar I" /> processed [[Bota/Legends|bota]]<ref name="TCSWE" />&mdash;a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] found on Drongar with substantial medicinal qualities&mdash;to save Maetrecis's life,<ref name="MedStar I" /> prompting him to begin making a fast recovery.<ref name="TCSWE" /> However, as using bota was illegal by Republic law, Yant kept the medicine in unmarked containers while administering it. Surgeon [[Jos Vondar]] and Yant later discussed Maetrecis' condition while checking over the major's vital signs, noticing that his condition had improved significantly since their last check in. When the major briefly woke up, Vondar reassured him everything was fine. When the surgeons left the room, Vondar berated the other doctor for using bota on the major, though Yant defended his actions, insisting he wanted to save lives.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
N'do Maetrecis first appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', which was written by by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] as the first installment of the [[MedStar Duology]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
